product_metadata.title: OBOR Organization and Storage, Under Sink Organizers and Storage for Kitchen, Expandable 2 Tier Cupboard Organizers and Storage for Bathroom/Kitchen/Balcony/Cloakroom
features: ✨Removable Plastic Shelves: The under kitchen sink organizers and storage has 10 solid removable plastic shelves included in the package, easy to assemble, move and clean.
✨Adjustable Storage Organizer: The kitchen organization and storage has 11 holes in vertical direction which you can adjust height according to your needs.

✨Expandable Organizers and Storage: The sink storage rack can be adjusted: length:15-26 inches (40-70 cm), depth:10.8 inches (28 cm), height:15.8 inches (40 cm). Please make sure to measure the size you need, avoid to bring a bad shopping experience for you.

✨Safe Recyclable Materials: The kitchen organization and storage is made of PP and stainless steel material, which is safe and absolutely harmless materials without BPA and any pollution. All of materials can be recycled. (❤️If you have any question,please feel free to contact us, we are here for help.❤️)

✨Essential Organization and Storage: The new multifunctional 2-layer under sink organizers and storage is perfect for saving space. Whether it is in the kitchen, bathroom, balcony, cloakroom, living room, office, garden or any other place where you want to organize extra space, you just need to use it according to your needs to keep everything organized.
